annotation.title_en: Information Security Policy - Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship website
annotation.summary_en: Internal information security policy of Jordan's Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship. It commits to confidentiality, availability and integrity of information assets, applies ISO 27001 through a steering committee, applies to staff and contractors, and bases controls on risk assessment. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry adopts ISO 27001 information security management system
Steering committee chaired by the Secretary General oversees information security
Policy binds permanent and temporary staff, contractors and partners
Controls based on risk assessment, business impact and cost-benefit comparison
Promotes security culture through professional training
